33.heading: grove:
refs: The original word eshel, has been variously translated a grove, a plantation, an orchard, a cultivated field, and an oak
but it may denote a kind of tamarisk, as it is rendered by Gesenius, the same with the Arabic athl.
Dr. Shuckford justly contends, that the expression rendered, "he called on the name," signifies "he invoked in the name."
